teaser: What happens when the drive to build something large meets the instinct to build it with people, not just for them. You are a life path 8, and the letters ENFJ sit on top of that like a second current running the same direction but not quite the same voltage. The 8 wants the company, the title, the number that proves the work mattered. The ENFJ wants the room to feel like it belongs to everyone in it. At a parent-teacher evening, you are the one who ends up running the schedule board, greeting the nervous new parent by name, and still noticing which teacher looks tired. Both things happen without you deciding to do either.
excerpt: Three times you have rearranged your week around someone else's deadline before mentioning your own.
